verses.text_en:
And in that place I saw the fountain of righteousness,
Which was inexhaustible:
And around it were many fountains of wisdom;
And all the thirsty drank of them,
And were filled with wisdom,
And their dwellings were with the righteous and holy and elect.
verses.text_hr:
Na tome sam mjestu vidio neiscrpan izvor pravednosti.
Oko njega su bili mnogi izvori mudrosti;
svi žedni pili su iz njih
i ispunili se mudrošću,
a njihova prebivališta bila su s pravednima, svetima i izabranima.

verses.text_en:
And at that hour that Son of Man was named
In the presence of the Lord of Spirits,
And his name before the Head of Days.
verses.text_hr:
U tome je času taj Sin Čovječji bio imenovan
u nazočnosti Gospodara duhova,
a njegovo ime pred Glavom Dana.

verses.text_en:
Yea, before the sun and the signs were created,
Before the stars of the heaven were made,
His name was named before the Lord of Spirits.
verses.text_hr:
Još prije nego što su stvoreni sunce i znakovi,
prije nego što su načinjene zvijezde nebeske,
njegovo je ime bilo izgovoreno pred Gospodarom duhova.

verses.text_en:
He shall be a staff to the righteous whereon to stay themselves and not fall,
And he shall be the light of the Gentiles,
And the hope of those who are troubled of heart.
verses.text_hr:
On će biti štap na koji će se pravedni oslanjati da ne padnu,
svjetlost narodima
i nada onima kojima je srce izmučeno.

verses.text_en:
All who dwell on earth shall fall down and worship before him,
And will praise and bless and celebrate with song the Lord of Spirits.
verses.text_hr:
Svi stanovnici zemlje past će ničice i pokloniti se pred njim
te hvaliti, blagoslivljati i pjesmom slaviti Gospodara duhova.

verses.text_en:
And for this reason hath he been chosen and hidden before Him,
Before the creation of the world and for evermore.
verses.text_hr:
Zato je bio izabran i skriven pred njim
još prije stvaranja svijeta i zauvijek.

Mudrost Gospodara duhova objavila ga je svetima i pravednima,
jer je sačuvao baštinu pravednih.
Oni su zamrzili i prezreli ovaj svijet nepravde
i u ime Gospodara duhova zamrzili sva njegova djela i putove.
U njegovo se ime spašavaju,
a prema njegovoj dobrohotnosti određeno je što će biti s njihovim životom.

U one će dane kraljevi zemlje postati oborena lica,
kao i snažni koji posjeduju zemlju, zbog djela svojih ruku.
U dan svoje tjeskobe i nevolje neće se moći spasiti.

verses.text_en:
And I will give them over into the hands of Mine elect:
As straw in the fire so shall they burn before the face of the holy:
As lead in the water shall they sink before the face of the righteous,
And no trace of them shall any more be found.
verses.text_hr:
Predat ću ih u ruke svojih izabranih.
Kao slama u vatri gorjet će pred licem svetih;
kao olovo u vodi potonut će pred licem pravednih
i više im se neće naći nikakva traga.

verses.text_en:
And on the day of their affliction there shall be rest on the earth,
And before them they shall fall and not rise again:
And there shall be no one to take them with his hands and raise them:
For they have denied the Lord of Spirits and His Anointed.
The name of the Lord of Spirits be blessed.
verses.text_hr:
U dan njihove nevolje na zemlji će zavladati mir,
a oni će pred njima pasti i neće više ustati.
Neće biti nikoga da ih uzme za ruku i podigne,
jer su zanijekali Gospodara duhova i njegova Pomazanika.
Neka je blagoslovljeno ime Gospodara duhova.
